posts.caption:
If you've ever paused mid-brush because your pup gave you the "really, again?" look, you're not alone. Keeping a grooming routine between salon visits can feel like a juggling act. Here are three simple habits that make the transition from scruffy to sleek easier and more stress-free:

• Brush regularly to smooth out tangles before they become mats
• Reward your dog with treats or play to make grooming a positive experience
• Use a damp cloth to reduce loose hair around the house
